name: Shared Terminal Login
summary: Shared terminal login dialog used for shared-workstation authentication and the manual switch-user flow launched from the shell user menu.

userActions: Authenticate at a shared terminal and continue safely
Authenticate after a manual logout without restarting the app
validationHints: Confirm shared terminal login continues to present and capture credentials correctly
Confirm the dialog can be reused for switch-user login after a shell logout
Confirm cancel and lockout paths still close the application safely when no active user session remains
